notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {R}
When Cult Conscript dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Davvol triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel
